study: Exploratory repair of blur negative transfer after the severity sweep
trigger: Observed noise-head worsening at blur sigma=4 on the known internal test; this is a targeted exploratory intervention, not independent confirmation
encoder_scaler: Original frozen 224px ImageNet ResNet-18 and clean-training scaler, unchanged
training_features: Reuse clean and seed-20261116 noise SD=0.1 training features; add Gaussian blur sigma=4 reflect, clipped and rounded uint8, on the same 4682 training cases
controls: Original clean-trained control and original half-clean/half-noise augmented head, unchanged
weighting: Each arm has total training weight N; no patient multiplication. The reduced-noise arm holds noise weight equal to mixed, distinguishing addition of blur examples from merely reducing noise weight. These are pipeline comparisons, not biological causal estimates.
selection: For each new arm, C grid [0.01,0.1,1,10], lbfgs max_iter=3000, lowest clean-selection NLL only; new cutoffs only from clean calibration 20th confidence quantile
primary: Mixed minus original noise-augmented risk at exactly 80% coverage under blur sigma=4; negative favors mixed
secondary: Same contrast against reduced-noise arm; clean and noise retention; full existing severity grid plus contrast and alternate noise seeds. Report every condition and all arms; no winner selection on tests.
scope: Known images and known corruptions, chosen intervention after observed failure; one encoder and fixed noise realization, conditional image bootstrap, no clinical/external-transfer or noninferiority claim. Historical heads and outputs remain unchanged.
